summary: Classify every no-commit tick as exactly one of gate-revert | voluntary-bail | platform-preempt on TickOutcome and in the §5 prior-attempt block

edit.description: Add a no-commit classification (gate-revert | voluntary-bail | platform-preempt) to TickOutcome and feed it into the §5 prior-attempt block; distinguish a clean agent exit w/o commit (voluntary-bail) from a non-work process failure (platform-preempt) from a committed-then-gate-reverted tick (gate-revert).
Three tests, one per mode, asserting distinct classification on TickOutcome + in the §5 forward block; voluntary-bail then retry → retry prompt names the prior bail + its constraint.

tests.asserts: one test per mode (gate-revert / voluntary-bail / platform-preempt) asserts the distinct TickOutcome classification + §5 block text; voluntary-bail→retry prompt names the prior bail + constraint (§6 acceptance)

acceptance: TickOutcome carries exactly one of gate-revert|voluntary-bail|platform-preempt per no-commit tick; each surfaces distinctly in the §5 block; voluntary-bail→retry prompt names the prior bail + constraint; pnpm test green
notes: TickOutcome at src/Dispatcher.ts (~204-212; shifts after LOOP-PROCESS-PER-TICK). Depends on GATE-FAILURE-FEEDBACK for the §5 block channel. Distinguishes the corpus-config-example voluntary-bail loop (5 sessions, same writablePaths wall) from the 17-session platform-preempt rate-limit run without reading session logs.

summary: afterMerge gate failure reverts only the offending entry's commit (not hardResetTo(preHead) whole-wave); N−1 clean siblings stay shipped; offending entry stays pending with the §5 block

edit.description: afterMerge gate failure: revert only the offending entry's merged commit instead of git.hardResetTo(repoRoot, preHead) whole-wave; keep the N−1 clean siblings shipped; the offending entry stays pending and its retry carries the §5 prior-attempt block. Per-entry agent parallelism unchanged.
Fanout N≥2, one entry's afterMerge gate fails → only that entry reverts + stays pending, others stay shipped; existing parallelism assertion stays green.

tests.asserts: N≥2 wave, one afterMerge gate fails → only the offending commit reverts, N−1 siblings stay shipped, offending stays pending w/ §5 block; fanout-parallelism assertion green (§7b acceptance)

acceptance: In an N≥2 wave with one afterMerge gate failure, only the offending entry reverts and stays pending, the other N−1 stay shipped, the retry carries the §5 block, and the parallelism assertion stays green; pnpm test green
notes: §7b — heaviest item by §12 (changes merge/revert granularity, not a parameter). Current whole-wave site: git.hardResetTo(repoRoot, preHead) in the afterMerge path (Dispatcher.ts ~496; shifts after upstream entries). Depends on GATE-FAILURE-FEEDBACK (retry carries §5 block). §7a/§7c are docs (CHAIN-AUTHORING-GATE-GUIDANCE); §7c (v) is docs-only per §12, no runtime entry.

summary: A gate-reverted plan tick must not silently destroy state.md/open-questions.md prose; recoverable without session logs (scope the revert to the failing artifact, or carry prose via the §5 block)

edit.description: On a gate-revert of a plan tick, do not silently drop the prose: either scope the revert to the failing machine-checkable artifact (e.g. pending.json) and keep state.md/open-questions.md, OR carry the prior prose into the next plan tick via the §5 block. Build picks one; recovery must never need session logs.
Plan tick writes open-questions.md/state.md + a pending.json that fails pendingParseGate → post-revert the findings are recoverable without session logs (on disk OR in the next plan tick's §5 block).

tests.asserts: plan tick: prose + schema-invalid pending.json → after revert, prose recoverable w/o session logs (on disk or next-tick §5 block) (§8 acceptance)

acceptance: A plan tick with prose + a pendingParseGate-failing pending.json leaves its findings recoverable after revert without session logs (on disk or in the next plan tick's §5 block); pnpm test green
notes: §8. Mechanism is build's choice; spec mandates the property (no silent prose loss). The §5-carry option needs GATE-FAILURE-FEEDBACK (blockedBy). Evidenced: pendingParseGate reverting 5f4b583 lost CLI-SEARCH-WALK/skill-path findings, hand-reconstructed in 9432489. pendingParseGate is the chain-local plan gate in .flume/chain.ts.
